subject: West African Traditional Religion
sourceFile: Arts & Humanities -- WEST AFRICAN TRADITIONAL RELIGION.txt
examFormat: Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting as a composite paper. Paper 1 has fifty multiple-choice objective questions, all answered in 50 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2 has three sections (A General Introduction to W.A.T.R.; B The Individual and the Community; C Contemporary Society), each with three essay questions; candidates answer four in all, at least one from each section, for 60 marks in 2 hours 10 minutes.
excluded: Afrikania Missions (Ghana), listed under New Religious Movements, omitted as Ghana-specific.
